name: Automatic Occlusion Volume Generation via Voxelization and Box Expansion
definition: A technique to automatically generate conservative, simple occlusion volumes for HZB-OC by voxelizing a mesh, finding dense regions, expanding axis-aligned boxes, and merging them via CSG.
summary: This method generates conservative occlusion volumes for HZB-OC by voxelizing meshes and expanding axis-aligned boxes to cover solid regions, reducing overdraw unlike simple fill methods.
